title: When the Ember Turns Again
author: S. M. Hartwell
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
